2. The petitioner claims that the payment of compensation made under rehabilitation Scheme is not
liable to be deducted from the entitlement under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
3.

The petitioner has brought to the notice that similar issue is pending in Writ Petition No.3583 of
2022 in which notices have been issued.
4. Issue notice to the respondents, returnable after four weeks.
Learned Assistant Government Pleader waives notice on behalf of the State.
5. This petition be tagged with Writ Petition No.3583 of 2022.
